Fresh installs keep service environments, caches, and models under gary4local-data beside the selected app install folder, so both can live off C:.
SA3 uses Python 3.12 with AMD ROCm Windows PyTorch 2.9.1+rocm7.2.1 and includes the T5Gemma Transformers compatibility pin.
Save a Hugging Face read token, then test from Gary4JUCE: Jerry > sa3 > generate and make a short loop.

This preview uses the separate gary4local-rocm updater feed.
